decision_rule: Corrected: the value adds a fact the cited page does not show, tags a judgement, plan or verdict as stated, places a company-level or inferred-site fact at the plant, or the quote is not on the page. Confirmed: every additive clause is on the cited page (not only the quoted fragment) or on a sibling row of the same claim_id whose source was opened on 2026-11-13 (this ledger repeats a compound value on every row of a claim; round 3 judged multi-row welder_postings the same way). A clause found only under a different claim (e.g. existing_robots, welder_postings) counts as additive. Limiting parentheticals ('not mandatory overtime', 'not shown to be welded here') and source notes ('AISC lists it as Middlefield') are not additive. Sensitivity: under a strict page-only reading, which also corrects the 3 CRH parent rows, the 5 Meyer posting rows whose street comes from the job-board API and inferred row 2615, the Meyer name label, the Burton city source note and the 2 'structural wind towers' rows, the rate is 20/125 = 0.16.
repeated_kinds: quote does not support value (8 of 8 corrections). Sub-patterns for the sweep: (a) a qualification read as the plant's process: Ameron 66th St weld_processes (Foreman 'highly preferred' flux/metal core; score impact) and Valley's 'GMAW on the seam welders' (a GMAW test); (b) a 2011 plan written as current products at a site tied by inference (Ameron 66th St products x2); (c) a compound clause taken from another claim's page (Valley production_type 'Moto cell', Burton weld_processes 'two postings / MIG Welder/Fitter'); (d) a detail or legal name not on the cited page (HW 'transmission poles', Ameron 'high mast', Ameron 'Ameron Pole Products LLC' on the EPA FRS page).
